Each module of GlassNN names, in its docstring, the chapters that explain
it. The table inverts these links: for every chapter, the modules it
covers, each linked to its page in the API reference. It is built from the
code when the book is rendered, so it is always current.

Chapters 7 (memorization), 11 (autoencoders) and 12 (PyTorch) build on the
example notebooks and the PyTorch notebooks rather than on a module of
their own.
